Why kindergarteners beat MBAs

Kids start with the marshmallow and prototype from the first minute. Business students spend most of the time planning, then put the marshmallow on with seconds to go — and watch it buckle.

The marshmallow is every project's hidden assumption. It looks light. Test it early and often.
